name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Iconic Mother
briefDescription: The award recognizes eminent senior citizens and institutions for their distinguished service to elderly persons, especially the indigent.
descriptionMd: The National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman) aims to recognize and honor eminent and outstanding senior citizens. It also acknowledges institutions and organizations that render distinguished service for the cause of elderly persons, particularly indigent senior citizens. These awards highlight exemplary contributions to the welfare and empowerment of the elderly community across the nation.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition as an eminent and outstanding senior citizen.
- Public honor conferred by the Hon’ble President of India.
- Acknowledgment for distinguished service to elderly persons.
- Promotes the cause of elder care and welfare.
eligibilityMd:
- Open to eminent and outstanding senior citizens.
- Open to institutions/organizations involved in rendering distinguished service for the cause of elderly persons.
- Specific focus on service for indigent senior citizens.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
